Thanks for the attachments — received both. High level answers below and then a proposed configuration.

Short answers:
- Invoice originator: Redwood Inference (we can list "Redwood Inference — Redwood Ltd. (EU entity)" or a US entity if you prefer; need confirmation of the legal entity you want on the invoice).
- Delivery: we support portal push as primary and can send a PDF copy to ap@acmehealth.com in parallel.
- AP requirements: we can include the PO number on the invoice, and map remittance codes into the invoice reference field.

Proposed configuration for go-live:
1) Invoice originator = Redwood Ltd. (EU VAT ID will be included) — confirm if that matches your accounting/ERP mapping.
2) Primary delivery = SFTP/API portal push to your collector (we will use the portal channel you included in the AP routing doc).
3) Secondary delivery = automated emailed PDF to ap@acmehealth.com (subject line will include invoice number + PO).
4) VAT evidence: we will store the VAT certificate on record and flag invoices as VAT-exempt/standard as appropriate. If you need self-billing or reverse-charge flags, let us know.

Connor and Kimberly — please confirm that we can set the originator as Redwood Ltd. and implement parallel email copies to AP. Also flag any SLA or batching constraints (Connor) or billing contact changes (Kim).

Best,
